title: Tensor-power addition comparison under open restriction
statement: Let $j:Y\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $n,b\in\mathbb N$, and $V\subseteq Y$ open. Use restriction [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], tensor powers and their addition isomorphism $A_{n,b}:L^{\otimes(n+b)}\cong L^{\otimes n}\otimes L^{\otimes b}$ [def-sc-invertible-module], and the canonical recursive comparison $P_n:(L^{\otimes n})|_Y\cong (L|_Y)^{\otimes n}$ [def-sc-tensor-power-open-restriction-comparisons]. Write $r_k$ for the canonical section isomorphism from the restriction of $L^{\otimes k}$ over $V$ to its ambient sections over $j(V)$. For any $z\in\Gamma(V,(L|_Y)^{\otimes n})$ and $w\in\Gamma(V,(L|_Y)^{\otimes b})$, one has $r_{n+b}(P_{n+b}^{-1}(A_{n,b,Y}^{-1}(z\otimes w)))=A_{n,b,X}^{-1}(r_n(P_n^{-1}(z))\otimes r_b(P_b^{-1}(w)))$. No section of $L$, invertibility, or quasi-coherence is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01CD, lemma-tensor-product-pullback, iterated with unit and associator coherence. Official Stacks page https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CD (proof omitted there; expanded here).

proof.text: The inverse tensor comparison of [def-sc-tensor-power-open-restriction-comparisons] carries a pure tensor of restricted sections to its ambient tensor by [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-tensor-comparison]. For binary tensor morphisms, cancel the sheafification comparison and use Mathlib PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction followed by sectionwise TensorProduct.induction_on. For triple tensors, the image sieve of the inner tensor sheafification unit is covering by Mathlib Presheaf.imageSieve_mem. On this sieve sectionwise tensor induction and naturality give equality; separatedness of the target sheaf gives equality on the original open. This checks arbitrary sections locally, without claiming pure tensors generate global sections.

Induct on n in tensorPowAddIso of [def-sc-invertible-module], proving addition_comparison as an equality of sheaf morphisms. Eliminate exponent equalities to commute equality transport with the recursive comparisons of [def-sc-tensor-power-open-restriction-comparisons], and cancel the final transport isomorphism. At n=0 use binary tensor extensionality, the left-unitor section formula, and linearity for the scalar action transported by restrictUnitIso. In the successor case use local triple-tensor extensionality, expand the associator and tensor-morphism section formulas, expand the recursive power inverse using the inverse tensor comparison, and evaluate the induction hypothesis on the remaining two factors. Finally evaluate the morphism equality on tmulSection z w over V; restrictAppIso is definitionally the required section identification.

lean.statement:
theorem openRestrictionTensorPowIso_inv_add {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) (n b : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    (z : Γ((L.restrict j).tensorPow n, V))
    (w : Γ((L.restrict j).tensorPow b, V)) :
    ((L.tensorPow (n + b)).restrictAppIso j V).hom
        ((openRestrictionTensorPowIso j L (n + b)).inv.app V
          (((L.restrict j).tensorPowAddIso n b).inv.app V (tmulSection z w))) =
      (L.tensorPowAddIso n b).inv.app (j ''ᵁ V)
        (tmulSection
          (((L.tensorPow n).restrictAppIso j V).hom
            ((openRestrictionTensorPowIso j L n).inv.app V z))
          (((L.tensorPow b).restrictAppIso j V).hom
            ((openRestrictionTensorPowIso j L b).inv.app V w)))
